report.summary: An incident occurred at 2026-10-06T13:14:00+00:00 causing database connection errors in payments-api and ledger-service. The investigation confirms that a configuration change (chg-8919) at 13:12 UTC reduced ledger-service database pool max size from 50 to 5, resulting in immediate connection pool exhaustion and elevated error rates.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Database connection pool size reduction in ledger-service

supporting.note: Config change reduced ledger-service db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 right before onset
Latency began rising sharply starting at 13:14 UTC
Error rate surged starting at 13:15 UTC
Ledger-service logged HikariPool-1 connection timeout errors with active=5 and high waiting requests
Payments-api logged downstream connection acquisition failures when calling ledger-service
Routine deploy chg-8200 occurred on event-bus shortly before the incident

contradicting.note: Directly links the connection pool exhaustion to ledger-service configuration change rather than event-bus
Logs specifically point to ledger-service database connection pool exhaustion rather than event-bus failures

facts.text: ledger-service latency_p99_ms began rising at 2026-10-06T13:14:00+00:00, reaching a peak of 7278.17ms at 13:41:00+00:00.
ledger-service error_rate_pct started its anomalous increase at 2026-10-06T13:15:00+00:00, peaking at 10.25%.
payments-api error_rate_pct started its anomalous increase at 2026-10-06T13:15:00+00:00, peaking at 8.26%.
ledger-service first logged HikariPool-1 connection timeout errors at 2026-10-06T13:15:05+00:00 indicating connection pool exhaustion (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=434).
payments-api first logged downstream connection acquisition failures when calling ledger-service at 2026-10-06T13:15:02+00:00.
A configuration change chg-8919 occurred on ledger-service at 2026-10-06T13:12:00+00:00, normalizing db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5.

assumptions: The reduction of the connection pool size to 5 was inadequate for handling normal traffic volume received by ledger-service.

timeline.event: Config change chg-8919 on ledger-service normalizing db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5
ledger-service and payments-api error rates begin anomalous increase
payments-api logs downstream connection acquisition failures
ledger-service logs HikariPool-1 connection timeout errors

recommended_actions.action: Immediate rollback or update of ledger-service configuration to restore db.pool.max_size back to 50.
recommended_actions.rationale: Configuration change chg-8919 directly caused database connection pool exhaustion and elevated error rates.

recommended_actions.action: Review configuration sync automation to ensure changes do not inappropriately override critical resource parameters.
recommended_actions.rationale: The change was introduced via config-sync normalizing parameters across services without accounting for specific throughput needs.

recommended_actions.action: Implement validation checks and automated alerting for database connection pool parameters and pool exhaustion metrics across all core microservices.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures similar misconfigurations are caught and alerted before causing widespread customer-facing payment failures.
